page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard3.Flex.16-128 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 instruction set architecture. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8358 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The configuration allocates 16 dedicated physical cores with multithreading enabled at two threads per core, yielding 32 virtual CPUs (vCPUs). System memory capacity is 128.0 GB, establishing a standard memory density of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This server instance does not include bundled local NVMe storage, requiring operating systems and application data to rely on attached network block volumes. It features no discrete GPU hardware acceleration, focusing its capacity purely on general compute tasks. Network provisioning includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory profile delivers balanced compute and memory capacity for enterprise workloads that do not demand local scratch storage or specialized acceleration. Appropriate use cases include intermediate application servers, container orchestration nodes, backend microservices, build pipelines, and relational database services using remote block volumes.
